name: Our Table
intro: You will start Our Table fresh, add three family dinners, plan the week with them and start a shopping list. Then we check it remembers everything after a reload and with no internet.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to Our Table”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own” (scroll the card up a little if you can’t see it all).
steps.see: A small question box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” with Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Tap “OK”.
steps.see: A card asks “What would you like to do?” with four big choices: “📅 Plan a meal”, “🗓 This week’s dinners”, “📖 My recipes” and “🎬 Watch how it works”. Under them are two smaller links: “↩ Pick up where I left off” and “🎬 Show me around this app”.

steps.do: Tap “📖 My recipes”.
steps.see: The Recipes page: a box called “Put your own dinners in” with a green “Add” button, and further down “No recipes match. Tap ＋ New to add one.” (the three example recipes are gone).

steps.do: Without typing anything, tap the green “Add” next to the empty box.
steps.see: Nothing is added — the page still says “No recipes match.”

steps.do: Tap the box under “Put your own dinners in”, type the dinner below, then tap the green “Add”.
steps.see: 🍲 Grandma's chili appears in the list with “no tags” and “0 made”, and the box says “1 of your own so far”. (On some phones a card “Keep Our Table on your Home Screen” also pops up; on many Android phones it does not.)

steps.do: If a “Keep Our Table on your Home Screen” card appears, tap “Later”. On many Android phones it does not appear — then just go on.
steps.see: No Home Screen card is covering the list.

steps.do: In the same box, type the next dinner (keep the apostrophe) and tap “Add”.
steps.see: O'Brien's casserole appears above Grandma's chili, spelled correctly, and the box says “2 of your own so far”.

steps.do: Tap “Grandma's chili” in the list.
steps.see: A card opens for Grandma's chili: “Ingredients — none written down yet” and the buttons “✓ Made it tonight”, “📅 Put it on a night”, “✏️ Edit” and “Close”.

steps.do: Tap “📅 Put it on a night”.
steps.see: The 📅 This week page opens (“Week of …”). The top night shows 🍲 Grandma's chili; every other night says “tap to choose…”.

steps.do: Tap “tap to choose…” on the second night down.
steps.see: A list opens titled “Dinner on …” with “✍️ Something else” and your two dinners: O'Brien's casserole and Grandma's chili.

steps.do: Tap “O'Brien's casserole” in that list.
steps.see: The list closes and the second night now shows 🍲 O'Brien's casserole (the top night is still Grandma's chili).

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “✨ Fill the blanks for me”.
steps.see: The empty nights fill with your two dinners and a short note says “Week filled — swap any night”. (Friday or Saturday may be left blank on purpose, for a night out.) A moment later a card says “The week has dinners on it. 👏” and offers Level 2 · The shopping list.

steps.do: Tap “Yes — Level 2”.
steps.see: The line near the top now says “🌿 Level 2 · The shopping list”, and a button “🧺 Make my shopping list from these dinners” is under the week.

steps.do: Tap “🧺 Make my shopping list from these dinners”.
steps.see: The 🧺 Shopping page opens. Because your dinners don’t have ingredients written in yet, it says “Nothing yet. Plan the week, then tap “Build the shopping list”.” — that is expected for now.

steps.do: Tap the “Add: milk, bananas…” box, type the item below, then tap “Add”.
steps.see: Under “OTHER” you see Margaret's coffee with “🏠 Have it” and ✕ buttons, and the top line says “1 to get · 0 in the cart”.

steps.do: Tap the little square box in front of Margaret's coffee.
steps.see: It gets a blue tick, the words are crossed out, and the line says “0 to get · 1 in the cart”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The app opens on the 📖 Recipes page with O'Brien's casserole and Grandma's chili still there, and the top line still says Level 2 · The shopping list.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Type this in the “Put your own dinners in” box and tap “Add”:
steps.see: A yellow strip says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Pastor Dan's pot roast appears at the top of your recipes.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off, then scroll down through your recipes.
steps.see: All three of your dinners are there, spelled right: Pastor Dan's pot roast, O'Brien's casserole and Grandma's chili. You added three dinners, planned a week and started a shopping list.
